question: Two withheld sentences had their exKana corrected in v1.35 (docs/measurements/v135-residue-manifest.json), so their recorded evidence described sentences that no longer exist. Each was re-labelled to a one-row evidence class and re-measured with instrument 1b on the corrected tokens, as v1.29 did for the 'nearest' class. Audio caches were outside the repo (DICTATION_WAV_CACHE).

n4-g386.rebuildIdentity: 1/1 — string handling only, no linguistic weight
n4-g386.positiveControl: instrument 1 proved 39 sentences say their corpus reading; 1b contradicts 0

n2-b103.rebuildIdentity: 1/1 — string handling only, no linguistic weight
n2-b103.positiveControl: instrument 1 proved 39 sentences say their corpus reading; 1b contradicts 0

n4-g386.detail: the disputed 何 is confirmed: 先生は週末になにをなさいますか。 renders byte-identical to the exJP audio (sha1 a37b031b019b); the なん substitution does not (da502d68d3a2). The corpus now says なに, so the record's own complaint '何 なん -> なに' is what the correction applied.

n2-b103.detail: 1b: 私 = わたし, not the corpus わたくし. Also 金 = きん, not the corrected かね: 彼は私をだましてきんを奪った。 and かれはわたしをだましてきんをうばった both render byte-identical to the exJP audio (fce72e22e1ab); the かね spellings do not (11f074e1b3a3). The correction to かね rests on the meaning, not on the voice.

alsoChecked.n3-k030: exJP changed ジェットきに乗る。 -> ジェット機に乗る。 and the sentence is in the dictation pool. Both render byte-identical (sha1 1b8ed80de3c9), so its dictation audio does not change.
